{"code":"    def should_refresh_entry(self, entry: DnsEntry, now: float) -> bool:
        """Decide whether *entry* is stale and should be refreshed.

        BUG_44: the comparison used to be inverted -- it returned ``True`` when
        the entry was still fresh and ``False`` when it was actually stale.
        """
        return now >= entry.stale_at","comments":"Fixes BUG_44 by returning True when current time has reached or passed stale_at, so stale entries are refreshed."}
